titleHistory.title: This Is A Test Of The Emergency Broadcast System.

games.description: Eight recorded visits to the roguelite shooter, mixing solo and co-op runs. Sark experiments with weapons and character builds, tackles bosses and daily challenges, and returns for the later classes and Reincarnation difficulty, ending the latest visit with a boss victory that unlocks Reincarnation Four.
games.title: Gunfire Reborn

games.description: Sark attempts UndreamedPanic’s camping horror game, reads the South Point Meadows introduction and Lamphead instructions, but repeated launch failures crash OBS before a successful playthrough begins.
games.title: Siren Head

games.description: Sark looks for his parents in a cornfield, wastes a paper-airplane distraction and tries the maze’s key puzzle before a broken game-over state ends the attempt.
games.title: Siren Head Field

games.description: Sark searches a dark forest for the parts needed to repair his car. Navigation, limited visibility and the siren creature turn the scavenger hunt into repeated attempts before he moves on.
games.title: Siren Head: Awakening

games.description: Sark searches a mountainous forest for keys and a way out while Siren Head repeatedly interrupts the trip. A chest, a bloodied house and some abrupt deaths make this a short, confusing expedition.
games.title: Siren Head: Remastered

games.description: Sark repairs a car at an abandoned ranger station, escapes once, then returns for the muffler and the good ending. Afterwards he watches a walkthrough of the secret gnome ending.
games.title: Siren Head: Retribution

games.description: Sark follows a gas-station repair trail through the forest, tests a shortcut into the power station and returns to the intended route. Keys, fuel and breaker schematics eventually get the car moving again.
games.title: Siren Head: Stranded

games.description: Sark tries to escape the Siren’s Forest, investigating blood and missing teenagers along the way. Brightness settings, awkward movement and a vehicle ride complicate the short horror trip.
games.title: Siren Head: The Siren's Forest
